project.title: Native password-to-MFA transaction
project.goal: Connect native password verification to exact current credential rows with unlocked KDF and locked revalidation
project.scope: R04/R41 internal credential transaction; no session issuer, endpoint or physical handle admission

boundary.responsibility: Read candidate, unlock KDF, revalidate and commit pending-factor continuation
boundary.rationale: Remove Bun credential lookup while fencing concurrent control changes
excludes: Complete authentication/session/MFA/HTTP lifecycle and physical handle admission

action.password_login.description: Verify existing password and commit a current pending-factor continuation

errors.refused: Opaque invalid_credentials, invalid_control, connection_refused, control_busy_or_unavailable, transaction_refused; stage and reusable flag distinguish unknown commits

preconditions: Trusted caller owns actual handle/lifetime admission and bounded blocking/rate limits; callback is synchronous transaction-local pending-factor Rust code
postconditions: Known commit returns continuation value only; no session/MFA completion or company authority
Failure rolls back or records outcome unknown and retires connection
external_effects: Declared control transaction writes performed by trusted continuation

authorization.rationale: Password is first factor only; unlocked KDF must revalidate exact current rows and held writer must cover pending-factor commit
